Implementation is complete.

## What I did

I ran the full OpenSpec workflow for the change `apply-coupon-to-order`, then implemented it.

**Planning artifacts** (validated with `openspec validate --strict`, all 4 complete):

- [proposal.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/proposal.md) — why and what, plus the new `order-coupon` capability
- [specs/order-coupon/spec.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/specs/order-coupon/spec.md) — 15 requirements covering normalization, validation order, all three discount rules, atomic persistence, error precedence, and no-side-effects
- [design.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/design.md) — layering, validation order, and the single-transaction repository decision
- [tasks.md](/work/openspec/changes/apply-coupon-to-order/tasks.md) — 7 tasks, all marked done

**Code** (kept inside the existing layers):

- [orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts:53) — all rules: trim/uppercase, the exact section-6 check order using the injected `Clock`, discount math (FIXED, `floor` PERCENT, cap, clamp to amount), then the atomic write
- [orderRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/orderRepository.ts:62) — `applyCoupon` runs the order update, redemption insert, and `used_count + 1` in one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`/`COMMIT` with `ROLLBACK` on failure
- [routes/orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts:11) — thin `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` route
- [app.ts](/work/src/app.ts:33) — wires the shared coupon repository into the order service

**Tests**: [apply-coupon.test.ts](/work/tests/apply-coupon.test.ts) — 27 tests mapping to every AC and REQ, including error precedence, window boundaries, no-side-effect rejections, and a repository-level rollback test.

## Verification

- `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit): passes
- `npm test`: 32 passed (5 existing + 27 new)
- `TASK.md` and `tests/orders.test.ts` are untouched; no schema changes and no new dependencies.

The change is ready; the `## Workflow follow-up` section notes archiving as the next optional step, which I left for you since you asked me to stop once implementation was complete.
